NOT_PREREGISTERED.title: Hypothesis not pre-registered
NOT_PREREGISTERED.why: Without a hypothesis locked before the run, the question can be chosen after the answer.

PIT_VIOLATION.title: Look-ahead: data used before it was available
PIT_VIOLATION.why: Rows whose availability time is after the decision time leak future information.

SURVIVORSHIP_BIAS.title: Survivorship-biased dataset
SURVIVORSHIP_BIAS.why: A universe of today's survivors omits the losers that were delisted.

UNADJUSTED_PRICES.title: Prices not adjusted for corporate actions
UNADJUSTED_PRICES.why: Splits and dividends create fake returns in unadjusted prices.

HOLDOUT_IMPLICIT_ACCESS.title: Undeclared use of the sealed holdout
HOLDOUT_IMPLICIT_ACCESS.why: Results reach into the holdout window without opening it in the ledger.

HOLDOUT_OVERUSE.title: Holdout evaluated more often than allowed
HOLDOUT_OVERUSE.why: Every look at the holdout turns it a little more into training data.

HYPOTHESIS_AMENDED_AFTER_RESULTS.title: Hypothesis changed after results were seen
HYPOTHESIS_AMENDED_AFTER_RESULTS.why: Rewriting the hypothesis to fit the data (HARKing) makes it unfalsifiable on that data.

PREDICTION_REVERSED.title: Predicted direction reversed after results
PREDICTION_REVERSED.why: Flipping the sign of a prediction after seeing the result is the strongest form of HARKing.

AMENDED_TESTED_ON_SEEN_DATA.title: Amended hypothesis confirmed on data already seen
AMENDED_TESTED_ON_SEEN_DATA.why: An amended hypothesis needs fresh data; the windows it was formed on cannot confirm it.

EXCESSIVE_TUNING.title: Many configurations tried
EXCESSIVE_TUNING.why: The best of many trials is biased upwards; significance must be deflated by the trial count.

SIGNIFICANCE_LOST_AFTER_DEFLATION.title: Significant only before deflation
SIGNIFICANCE_LOST_AFTER_DEFLATION.why: The Sharpe ratio is significant alone but not after accounting for the trials.

HIGH_PBO.title: High probability of backtest overfitting
HIGH_PBO.why: The in-sample winner tends to rank below the median out of sample.

TEST_WINDOW_REUSE.title: Test window evaluated by many trials
TEST_WINDOW_REUSE.why: Each trial evaluated on the same test window is another test of it; p-values are adjusted.

SHORT_OOS.title: Short out-of-sample window
SHORT_OOS.why: Less than a year of out-of-sample data cannot separate skill from luck.

NO_OOS.title: No out-of-sample evaluation
NO_OOS.why: Everything was evaluated on the data used to build it.

IS_OOS_DEGRADATION.title: Out-of-sample performance collapses
IS_OOS_DEGRADATION.why: An out-of-sample Sharpe under half the in-sample one suggests overfitting.

FRAGILE_PEAK.title: Isolated parameter peak
FRAGILE_PEAK.why: Neighbouring parameter values perform much worse: the optimum may be noise.

OUTLIER_DEPENDENCE.title: Driven by a few periods
OUTLIER_DEPENDENCE.why: Trimming the 1% best and worst periods removes the profit.

IMPLAUSIBLE_SHARPE.title: Implausibly high Sharpe ratio
IMPLAUSIBLE_SHARPE.why: Sharpe ratios above 3 in daily backtests usually mean leakage or an error.

SINGLE_REGIME.title: Profitable in one regime only
SINGLE_REGIME.why: Performance depends on a single market state.

CODE_NOT_VERSIONED.title: Code version not pinned
CODE_NOT_VERSIONED.why: Uncommitted or unhashed code cannot be re-run exactly.

MISSING_SEED.title: No random seed recorded
MISSING_SEED.why: Stochastic steps without a seed are not reproducible.

NONREPRODUCIBLE.title: Re-run did not reproduce the result
NONREPRODUCIBLE.why: The recorded result could not be regenerated from the recorded inputs.

DATA_INTEGRITY.title: Dataset no longer matches its hash
DATA_INTEGRITY.why: The data behind the result changed.

LICENSED_DATA.title: Licensed data
LICENSED_DATA.why: Vendor terms may forbid publishing row-level data or derived series.
